The process of water changing from a liquid to a gas at the surface of an ocean, lake, or river is called

Though water vapor is not visible, it makes up part of the air that surrounds us. When water vapor rises in the atmosphere, it can cool down enough to form water droplets around particles in the air, changing back into liquid water. The liquid water is visible in the form of clouds. The process of water changing from a gas to a liquid is called
